title: evidence_manifest.csv content contract
description: Describes evidence_manifest.csv: a flat table, so the shared provenance envelope's six leaf columns are flattened onto each row (a CSV cannot nest a provenance object). One row per claim-to-source mapping; claim_id binds this manifest to decision_memo.pdf's gap_list and to any deliverable_field's claim of support.

columns.description: The exact CSV header row, in this exact order.

claim_id.description: A unique identifier for the claim this row supports. Binds to a decision_memo.pdf gap_list entry's claim_id when that specific claim is refused instead of answered.

claim_text.description: A short restatement of the claim being evidenced, for human auditability.

deliverable_field.description: The published output field name (from case/scripts/field_vocabulary.py's ALL_PUBLISHED_NAMES) that this claim supports. Required to be a published vocabulary name, which is what lets the grounding checker resolve pointers mechanically.

support_type.description: Whether the cited source supports, contradicts, or is insufficient to resolve the claim.

resolution_rule_applied.description: The in-corpus governing-document rule that resolved this claim when more than one candidate source existed.

source_document_id.description: The corpus document identifier this claim was sourced from (flattened from the shared provenance envelope).

structural_identifier.description: The primary locator within the source document (flattened from the shared provenance envelope).

page_hint.description: An advisory page reference for human convenience only; never scored (flattened from the shared provenance envelope).

document_effective_date.description: The date the source document itself became effective or was executed (flattened from the shared provenance envelope).

retrieved_date.description: The date this source was retrieved or last checked (flattened from the shared provenance envelope).

source_sha256.description: The SHA-256 hex digest of the source artifact (flattened from the shared provenance envelope).
